title: Horrible customer service !!!
text: Horrible customer service !!!. I will say, after owning the set a little over 4 months with light use, the exterior coloring was rubbing off and the non-stick was turning. Contacted Cuisinart customer service in good faith having the pots replaced. I offered pictures and the response was from them is to share what utensils I was using how much heat was underneath the pot and the cleaning methods !! Are you kidding me !! DO NOT buy anything from Cuisinart !! The warranty support is in the gutter !!!!

product_metadata.title: Cuisinart 17-Piece Cookware Set, Chef's Classic Nonstick Hard Anodized, 66-17
features: SET INCLUDES: 1 Quart saucepan with glass cover, 2 Quart saucepan with glass cover, 3 Quart saucepan with glass cover, 3.5 Quart sauté pan with helper and glass cover, 4 Quart dutch oven with glass cover, 8 Quart stockpot with glass cover, 8” nonstick skillet, 10” nonstick skillet, 12” nonstick skillet with glass cover, 20cm steamer insert with cover
SUPERIOR STRENGTH: The strong anodized exterior is harder than stainless steel. Each piece is dense, nonporous, and highly wear-resistant for extra durability and professional performance

PREMIUM COOKING: Experience professional performance with a premium nonstick cooking surface reinforced with Titanium, which provides lasting food release you can taste. Each piece is oven safe to 500 F, with glass lids that are oven safe up to 350 F. This cookware set gives you versatility to cook on the stovetop or in the oven

CLEANING & CARE: Care-cookware should be washed by hand with hot sudsy water and a sponge or soft dishcloth. Do not put in the dishwasher since harsh detergents will harm exterior finish of the cookware set

EXCEPTIONAL HANDLING: Cookware set equipped with solid stainless steel riveted stick handles that stay cool on the stovetop and provide a safe and solid grip every time. Each rim designed to be drip-free for a clean and precise pour
description: The 17-piece cookware set is perfect choice for serious cooks, big families, and anyone who likes to entertain at home, this Deluxe set includes everything the chef needs.
